_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Failed Item Analysis Report
summary: Specifies the format and content for the Failed Item Analysis report, which presents the results of failure analysis, methods of analysis, failure histories and corrective action taken or recommended for each failed item required to be analyzed.
use_relationship:
The Failed Item Analysis report is to be prepared for each failed item which is contractually required to be analyzed. It presents the results of failure analysis, methods of analysis, failure histories and corrective action taken or recommended.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Contractual Engineering Task (CET).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The following shall be included in the Failed Item Analysis report:

children.title: The Software Metrics Report shall include the following
Name of engineer responsible for failure analysis
Nomenclature and generic number of failed items
Type of test during which failure occurred
Operational and environmental conditions under which failure occurred
Description of failure systems by which failure was detected
Description of item's mode of failure
Description of specific laboratory method employed in failure analysis (e.g., x-ray, spectrographic analysis, dissection)
Impact, if any, of environmental conditions on the failure cause
Description of specific analytical method employed in identifying failure causes
Failure history to date of subject item
